cases.minimum_next_action: Export one bounded strict JSON record without duplicate keys, BOM, or nonfinite constants.

cases.condition: wavefunction format, safe basename, or filename suffix is inconsistent
cases.minimum_next_action: Correct the explicit format and label from producer evidence without inferring content from a renamed file.

cases.condition: actual wavefunction basename, SHA-256, or byte count differs or the path is not a single-link regular file
cases.minimum_next_action: Supply the exact original wavefunction bytes or rebuild the complete source evidence for new bytes.

cases.condition: element, charge sign, electron count, multiplicity parity, or ECP electron closure is inconsistent
cases.minimum_next_action: Repair the electronic-state and ECP metadata from the upstream producer record.

cases.condition: any parent input, output, electronic, or wavefunction-export acceptance gate is not exact pass
cases.minimum_next_action: Return to the upstream calculation Skill and complete all four independent acceptance gates.

cases.condition: raw parent hash and producer, structure, spin, electronic, basis, input, or output semantics detach from the projection
cases.minimum_next_action: Rebuild the semantic projection from the same raw parent record and current source semantics.
Select an exact profile already defined in the candidate version matrix.

cases.condition: profile is a community build or lacks exact version and platform regression evidence
cases.minimum_next_action: Add official or source-build parity, exact banner, versioned transcript, and legal fixtures.

cases.condition: native execution is requested but neither exact Multiwfn executable identity nor an available matching binary is established
cases.minimum_next_action: Keep the request documentation-only until an exact legal binary, digest, banner, settings, and platform profile are available.

cases.condition: the requested main function or subfunction is listed in the manual catalog but no exact recipe is established
cases.minimum_next_action: Capture the complete exact-version prompts, stdin, outputs, return tokens, and failure behavior before creating a recipe.

cases.condition: the selected noGUI/full mode cannot provide a required GUI step or the input family lacks data required by the analysis
cases.minimum_next_action: Choose a compatible distribution and semantically complete producer artifact; never infer missing basis, orbital, grid, atom, or GUI capability.

cases.condition: requested menu task is not the exact wavefunction-inventory route
cases.minimum_next_action: Create an independent exact-version menu contract and fixtures for the requested task.

cases.condition: transcript version repeats or drifts, protocol sentinels reorder, or fatal text appears
cases.minimum_next_action: Capture one complete stdin and stdout or stderr record from the exact profile after fixing the run.

cases.condition: charge table unit, indices, atom order, finite values, declared total, or charge conservation fails
cases.minimum_next_action: Regenerate the controlled charge interchange table while preserving source atom order and charge state.

cases.condition: output exists, aliases an input, or durable temporary write and atomic publish fails
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve all inputs and old targets, repair storage, and rerun with a new absent output path.

cases.condition: all requested candidate source, wavefunction, profile, transcript, and table gates pass
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the candidate report without authorizing execution or promotion and perform scientific suitability review separately.

cases.condition: No earlier case can be established from the available exact evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop and obtain the exact evidence needed to select one earlier Multiwfn case.
